company.name: Autograph
company.shortDescription: Autograph is an online platform that enhances sports fandom by offering news, tickets, scores, and merchandise to fans.
company.description: Autograph provides a platform for users to engage with sports, entertainment, and cultural content through personalized digital experiences. The company aggregates multimedia content such as podcasts, blogs, videos, and social posts, tailored to fans’ favorite teams and creators. It also offers digital collectibles and curated experiences in collaboration with athletes, entertainers, and brands. Autograph enables fans to explore updates and trends in one place, enhancing how they follow and interact with teams and public figures.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $170,000,000, or 82.93% of reported total funding.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $735,000,000 to $1,068,040,452, a 1.45x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
